Ar-Pharazôn lands here to humble Sauron — the haven's proudest and worst hour

timeline.cite: App A; LotR App B [C] — '830 Falastur begins the line of the Ship-kings of Gondor', '1050 Hyarmendacil conquers the Harad. Gondor reaches the height of its power', and '1149 Reign of Atanatar Alcarin begins'
timeline.what: The four Ship-kings: Umbar taken, the realm 'reached the summit of its power' under Hyarmendacil I

timeline.cite: App B [C] — both ends annalled: '933 King Eärnil I takes Umbar, which becomes a fortress of Gondor' and '1050 Hyarmendacil conquers the Harad'.
timeline.what: Gondor's zenith: the Ship-kings take Umbar; Hyarmendacil's peace

timeline.cite: App A; LotR App B [C] — both ends are annals: '933 King Eärnil I takes Umbar, which becomes a fortress of Gondor' and '1448 Rebels escape and seize Umbar'
timeline.what: Gondor takes Umbar (Eärnil I); the rebels of the Kin-strife flee here after 1448 — the Corsair age begins

timeline.cite: App B, the Tale of Years [C] — both ends annalled: '1015 King Ciryandil slain in the siege of Umbar' and '1050 Hyarmendacil conquers the Harad'.
timeline.what: Wars with Gondor's Ship-kings; Umbar's loss and the Harad kings' homage to Hyarmendacil

timeline.cite: App A; LotR App B [C] — every clause is an annal: '1432 King Valacar of Gondor dies, and the civil war of the Kin-strife begins', '1437 Burning of Osgiliath and loss of the palantír', '1448 Rebels escape and seize Umbar'
timeline.what: The Kin-strife: Castamir's usurpation, Osgiliath burned, the rebels to Umbar

timeline.cite: App A; LotR App B [C] — '1810 King Telumehtar Umbardacil retakes Umbar and drives out the Corsairs'
timeline.what: Telumehtar Umbardacil retakes it briefly; lost again to Harad

timeline.cite: App A; LotR V.9 [I-M] — the OPENING year is the archive's own placement. NO ANNAL DATES THE RAID: App A narrates it without a year — 'he came to Umbar unlooked for by night, and there burned a great part of the ships of the Corsairs' — and no Third Age entry in the Tale of Years mentions Umbar at all; its only Umbar annal is S.A. 3261. The closing year is sound: the Corsairs' end at Pelargir is March 3019, LotR V.9
timeline.what: Thorongil's raid burns the fleet; the Corsairs' last armament dies at Pelargir
